title: Automatic async error handling middleware
description: Provides a global middleware that automatically catches errors thrown in async route handlers and forwards them to the error handler, eliminating the need for repetitive try/catch blocks. Enhances reliability and developer ergonomics in production environments.
testCases: Async route throws an error and receives a standardized JSON error response with correct status code
Sync route throws an error and is handled identically
Successful async route returns expected payload without interference
acceptance: All async and sync route errors are captured, logged, and responded with a JSON payload containing { error: true, message, status }. No unhandled promise rejections occur, and normal routes behave unchanged.
reason: Reduces boilerplate and prevents uncaught promise rejections, leading to more stable production deployments and faster feature development.
